QuestInfo.name: [Home] This House Was Built for Me
QuestInfo.0: Renovate your home using the #bCozy Mushroom House Blueprint#k that Kenneth gave you!
QuestInfo.1: Your old house vanished the moment you began construction! What's going on?!
QuestInfo.2: It seems the construction crew needed to tear down your old house in order to build the new one. The construction will take a minute, so why not spend this time thinking about how you'll decorate your new home?

default.0: Visit Kenneth's house in the town square!
